name: cinematic-filmmaker
title: Cinematic filmmaker
description: Teaches the Assistant to make a short live-action-looking film end to end: script and shot list, character sheets saved as elements with voices, locations and a look, a keyframe then a video per shot, dialogue and sound, and the edit on the Timeline to an MP4.
author: helmstudio
may_do: Teach the Assistant scripting, shot lists, film craft and the order of work (text it reads)
Suggest image, video and voice settings as recipes (you still press Generate)
when: Making a short film, a scene or a trailer that should look live action: a script, a shot list, characters that stay the same, dialogue, and the edit to an MP4.

recipes.name: keyframe-still
recipes.title: Keyframe still, wide 1344 x 768
recipes.note: A shot's first frame at the film's aspect; same size as the LTX final shot so nothing is cropped.

recipes.name: keyframe-draft
recipes.title: Keyframe draft, Turbo
recipes.note: 8 fixed steps: try framing and composition fast, then the final with Base.

recipes.name: character-sheet
recipes.title: Character sheet, 1536 x 864
recipes.note: Turnaround and expressions on a plain background, wide so four views fit. Save the best take as an element.

recipes.name: character-sheet-h3
recipes.title: Character sheet, MiniMax H3 Image
recipes.note: A sharper, larger sheet (heavy: about 39 GB peak on a Mac, 2 to 2.5 min a run).

recipes.name: ltx-quick-draft
recipes.title: LTX shot draft, 4 s
recipes.note: The final's size and length, so the timing carries over. Pick One-stage in Quality: it renders half the canvas, so it is fast.

recipes.name: ltx-final-shot
recipes.title: LTX final shot, 1344 x 768, 4 s
recipes.note: Two-stage at the keyframe's size, 97 frames (LTX lengths are 8k + 1). Detail for a final close-up.

recipes.name: ltx-dialogue-shot
recipes.title: LTX Audio to video, lip movement
recipes.note: The voice line (up to 13.375 s) sets the length; add the keyframe so the face matches. Not a lip-sync model.

recipes.name: h3-references-shot
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 References, 5 s
recipes.note: At the film's 1344 x 768 (H3's largest canvas, so its peak memory is higher than the 864 x 480 default). Keeps characters and places from reference images; 124 frames at 24 fps (H3 lengths are 5 + 17k).

recipes.name: h3-references-draft
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 References, 5 s draft
recipes.note: A 4-step draft at the final's size and length, so the timing carries over to the 20-step final with the same seed.

recipes.name: h3-first-last-shot
recipes.title: MiniMax H3 Image to video, 5 s
recipes.note: At 1344 x 768 so it matches the keyframes (higher peak memory than the 864 x 480 default). First frame and / or Last frame: land a move exactly between two keyframes.

recipes.name: voice-line
recipes.title: Voice line, ZONOS3 neutral
recipes.note: One line in a character's saved voice; raise Energy or lower Emotion per line as the scene needs.

recipes.name: dialogue-scene
recipes.title: Dialogue scene, ZONOS3
recipes.note: A script of @name: lines, every @name in the Cast with a saved voice; one take for the whole exchange.
